'''Meebo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Meebo traveled to Dalicron-4 in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and established a business leading offworlders on hunting trips. He was based in the building [[Meebo's]], in the northwest edge of the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]], and he kept a dozen [[Cracian thumper]]s for use as mounts on his trips. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jhara]] borrowed a number of Cracian thumpers from Meebo.
